items.summary: Diagnose and fix the blank white screen issue preventing the application from rendering. Check for JavaScript errors in browser console, React component mounting failures, routing configuration issues in App.tsx, and ThemeProvider initialization problems.
Verify that frontend/src/main.tsx properly initializes the React application with RouterProvider, QueryClientProvider, and InternetIdentityProvider in the correct order without throwing errors.
Ensure App.tsx router configuration properly defines all routes including root landing page (/), dashboard routes, admin routes, and legal pages without circular dependencies or missing imports.

Verify that CSS is loading correctly by checking that frontend/index.html references the correct stylesheet, Tailwind CSS processes properly, and no critical CSS syntax errors prevent styles from applying.
